calibration.statement: Calibrated strictly by alert frequency budget (median <= 3, p95 <= 8 per stock-month) on historical data. Zero forward-return data was inspected or used in this calibration.

history.outcome: Exceeded frequency budget across full 433-stock replay (median 6.0, p95 14.0) due to zone-entry firing on intraday wicks, uncollapsed same-day alerts, and broad level qualification.

history.rationale: Zone entry restricted to close landing inside the zone. At most one level alert per level per day resolved by priority (Break > Zone Enter > Approach). Scale-aware 0.5% log grid buckets for swing level keys. Data-health alerts throttled with 5-day reminder and recovery note. Cooldown set to 5 trading days per (stock, kind, levelKey).
history.outcome: Budget failed on 433-stock replay and 25-stock sample: median 3.0, p95 9.0 (exceeded p95 <= 8.0 budget target due to zone-entry recurrence after 5 days during consolidation).

history.description: Cooldown tightening to 10 trading days and strict break date alignment
history.rationale: Cooldown lengthened to 10 trading days (two calendar trading weeks) scoped strictly per (stock, kind, levelKey) to prevent repeated approach and zone-entry noise during consolidation while guaranteeing prior approach/zone alerts never silence breaks. LEVEL_BREAK restricted strictly to brokenOn === evalDate (eliminating late sliding-window events).
history.outcome: Budget met on full 433-stock replay (91,188 stock-months): Median 2.0 <= 3.0, p95 8.0 <= 8.0, Mean 2.96. Note: 3.3% of stock-months are above 8, meeting the p95=8 budget at the exact edge. Step 6 tripwire recorded: if live alerts over first 20 trading days show p95 > 8 per stock-month, tighten once more by frequency only.

levelBreak.breakNote: In our test, breaks reversed more often than they continued

cooldown.rationale: 10 trading days (two calendar trading weeks) scoped strictly per (stock, kind, levelKey). Scoped per kind so an earlier approach or zone alert can never silence a subsequent break, while preventing repeated approach and zone-entry noise during consolidation to satisfy the <= 8.0 p95 monthly budget.

disclaimer: Reference only. Not a forecast. In our test of six rule sets on 433 stocks none showed an edge.
